obligations.description: Pay rent of $2,000 on the 1st of each month
obligations.source_text: Tenant shall pay $2,000 on the 1st of each month

obligations.description: Maintain heating, plumbing, and electrical systems
obligations.source_text: Landlord will maintain all major systems (heating, plumbing, electrical)
Tenant must report any issues within 24 hours

obligations.description: Provide 60 days written notice for termination
obligations.source_text: Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice

penalties.condition: Rent paid after the 5th of the month
penalties.source_text: Late payments after the 5th will incur a $75 late fee
Early termination by Tenant will result in forfeiture of security deposit
Unauthorized pets will result in immediate lease termination
